author: dr4kun
body:
The main problem for omnis coming from nekros is the loss of life siphon. Omnimancy is neat, and you get permanent resistance vs holy and dark (Apollyon uses holy, dark, arcane, and physical), but it's fiddly RNG and you already have high resistance. 

In this fight, you're primarily susceptible to high-damage physical hits from Omnistrike, Osmostrike, and Apocalypse. High % ornate nothren gear from t8 can get you far, but it's not enough to carry you alone.

FWIW, t9 Apollyon runs was the first time i started using ward as a mage, at all, in the game (ok, i would experiment with it a few times before and call it meh). Get a good t8/t9 shield and upgrade it, even as far as masterforge (bonus points for mighty griffin shield - it will serve you also vs Morrigan with +dragon aspect). Omnimancers have a high hp/mana pool, meaning they also get a high natural ward pool.

**For rotation:** 

* You typically want to get ward of mythril first (cast it once per fight and forget it), 
* golem's fortitude and barrier 2 up for defence, 
* fortify 3 to increase ward duration, 
* threaten / mute / outwill (i use them in that order, since physical attacks are the most scary for us), 
* wyvern's speed / jinn's talent (your offensive buffs come last - use potions if you have a lot of them and you don't have wyvern's speed yet). 
* Then you want to cast fortify 3 a bunch of times, since it allows you to stack ward - it gives you net +6 turns of ward, so you can keep casting fortify 3 until your ward lasts for the next 100 turns, and then forget about fortify (and mythril). 
* You want to cast mend wall 3 as you get down to \~half of your ward (it takes 3 turns now, but heals 50% of your total ward, not missing ward). Cast it throughout the fight.
* Get your Great Meditation up and fight under it. It's a fiddly mistress - sometimes will last for 10 turns, often for 1. Comes in the mage package \*sigh\*
* You will learn to juggle mend wall and great meditation, but it's frustrating. 
* Use transference to heal ward if you have it.
